description: Use this at the start of any portfolio, renewal or 'what do I own' question, before assuming which names the user holds. List the user's domain inventory: every domain with a verification challenge issued or completed, plus cached liveness, classification, title and expiry. Read-only. Cannot spend money. Includes scan_age_ms so a stale verdict is never mistaken for a fresh one. Use before suggesting the user buy anything.
name: list_domains
